01 / Who we are

What is SS?

A student-powered ecosystem. We don't just talk about careers — we open doors, run events, build products and lift each other up.

Community

Thousands of students connected across campuses — one network, zero gatekeeping.

Opportunities

Internships, jobs, ambassador roles, projects and talent showcases — all in one hub.

Services

SS Band, event management, IT solutions and student guidance — run professionally, priced for students.

Support

Guidance for student problems, career confusion and everything in between. Real people, real help.

05 / What we provide

SS services

Student-run, professional-grade. Approach us through the contact form on any service card.

SS Band

Live music for college fests, events and showcases.

  • Book the band for your event
  • Audition to join the band
  • Contact: band@ss-community.org

Event management

End-to-end event planning by students who run events every month.

  • College fests & summits
  • Workshops & sessions
  • Contact: events@ss-community.org

IT solutions

Websites, apps and tools — built by our student dev team.

  • Portfolio & business sites
  • Club/ fest management tools
  • Contact: it@ss-community.org

Guidance & support

Stuck with a student problem? Career confusion? Talk to us.

  • 1:1 guidance sessions
  • Career & internship advice
  • Contact: help@ss-community.org
